Jaṭhara : m. (pl.): Name of a Janapada.

Listed by Saṁjaya among the northern Janapadas (also called Deśas 6. 10. 68) of the Bhāratavarṣa (ata ūrdhvaṁ janapadān nibodha) 6. 10. 37, 5; jaṭharāḥ kukkuśāś caiva 6. 10. 41.
